description: This file contains the ZoneLoader class, which provides functionality to load zone configuration data from a JSON resource file and deserialize it into a map of zone transient objects.

classes.name: ZoneLoader
classes.description: A utility class responsible for loading and parsing zone configuration data from a JSON file into Java objects.

methods.name: loadZoneConfigurations
methods.description: Loads zone configuration data from a JSON resource file, converting the JSON data into a map of zone transient lists. Handles exceptions and logs errors.
